page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top centre. Page number at top right. No marginal notes. Catchword at lower right. Gathering signature at lower left.

main_text.p: bant imagini Beatae Virginis, ad quam (inquit ille) nescio cur haec gens, tam singularem demonstret devotionem: ea enim conspecta magnum ei honorem, reverentiam & benevolentiam exhibet. O praeconium Iesuita dignum! eant nunc & negent a se foveri idololatriam: hos sane Ethnicos quod imagines illorum adorarint commendant. Siccine Apostoli, sic illorum discipuli, & hos subsecuti ex patribus priores, regnum Dei atque Christi propagarunt? hiscine indiciis, religionem suorum discipulorum ac pietatem probarunt? Neque haec ipsis immunditia scortationis suae sufficit, inebriant & reliquis poculi Babylonici abominationibus gentes quas adeunt. Virtutem Sancti Spiritus in fide & praecibus residentem rejiciunt, fascinis incantamentisque meretricis Romanae suppositis: daemones si expellendi, aqua lustralis propinatur; si morbus soluendus, cera sacri, ut ajunt, Agni collo appenditur; incendium, imago hominis crucifixi hastili alligata ac flammis opposita, arcere miseris persuadetur. En Evangelium Iesuiticum quod murmure praecularum non intellectarum, certoque numero secundum globulorum ordinem recitatarum absoluitur;

page.notes: Long s (s) transcribed as plain s throughout. "hos sane" appears as "hosfane" in the scan; read as "hossane" with the word split as printed, doubtful. The word "opposita" contains a Cyrillic-looking letter in the transcription above; the intended word is Latin "opposita". Rendering of "fingularem" and "fcortationis" read with long s as singularem and scortationis. Running head "AD INDOS." and page number 37 are as printed. Catchword "flagel-" keeps its printed hyphen.
